name: Mummy Lord
languages: the languages it knew in life, plus one of choice

traits.text: Adhesive (Object Form Only). The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature ad- hered to the mimic has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have Disadvantage.

actions.name: Hit
actions.text: 10 (1d12 + 4) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Ne- crotic damage. Gore (Recharge 5–6). Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the minotaur moved 10+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition. actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The mummy makes two Rotting Fist at- tacks and uses Dreadful Glare.

actions.name: Rotting Fist
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target can’t regain Hit Points, its Hit Point maximum doesn’t return to normal when finishing a Long Rest, and its Hit Point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) every 24 hours that elapse. A creature dies and turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack.

actions.name: Dreadful Glare
actions.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, one creature the mummy can see within 60 feet. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the end of the mummy’s next turn.
